data.title: Story Map: The Lost Puppy's Journey Home

passage.title: The Long Way Home
passage.text: One chilly autumn evening, a golden retriever puppy named Buster found himself hopelessly lost in the dense, unfamiliar Whispering Woods as darkness began to fall like a heavy curtain. Buster, a courageous but frightened young dog, had chased a vibrant blue butterfly far away from the safety of his backyard. Driven by fierce determination, he scrambled over fallen logs and forged through prickly blackberry brambles as the howling wind threatened to push him backward. Suddenly, a flash of lightning illuminated a towering oak tree, and Buster recognized the distinct metal wind chime he had heard from his porch every single day. He sprinted toward the familiar sound with all his remaining energy, bursting through the treeline into his own brightly lit yard. There stood his worried owner, Sarah, waiting with open arms to welcome her exhausted pup safely home.
passage.author: Elena Rostova

characters.name: Buster
